# 91st Drama League Awards

| venue = The Ziegfeld Ballroom
}}
The 91st Drama League Awards were held on May 16, 2025, recognizing excellence in Broadway and Off-Broadway productions during the 2024–25 season. Nominations were announced on April 22, 2025, with Maybe Happy Ending receiving the most nominations with 10. It won the most awards of the night with two wins, tied with Sunset Blvd. and Oh, Mary!.
Winners and nominees
The 2024-2025 Drama League Awards nominations were announced on Tuesday, April 22, 2025, by current stars of The Great Gatsby and Cabaret, respectively, Sarah Hyland and Orville Peck. The awards ceremony took place on Friday, May 16, 2025, at the The Ziegfeld Ballroom, hosted by journalist Frank DiLella. Special awards recipients included:
*Kate Navin and Audible Theatre - Contribution to the Theatre Award
*Lea Salonga - Distinguished Achievement in Musical Theatre Award
*Whitney White -  Founders Award for Excellence in Directing
*Robert Greenblatt and Neil Meron - Gratitude Award
Winners included Oh, Mary, which received Outstanding Production of a Play and Outstanding Director of a Play for Sam Pinkleton; Maybe Happy Ending, which won Outstanding Production of a Musical and Outstanding Director of a Musical for Michael Arden; a tie between Eureka Day and Vanya for Outstanding Revival of a Play; and Sunset Blvd., which won Outstanding Revival of a Musical along with the Distinguished Performance awarded to Nicole Scherzinger.
